sonnet.problem: Story card 3 already quotes the LORD saying 'I appear in the cloud above the mercy seat.' That hands the baker the answer 'mercy seat' to the later fill-in-the-blank about the cloud covering the ___ above the Testimony.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Card 4 already showed the answer 'Wash his clothes and bathe' for the man who released the scapegoat. Card 7 reuses that same fact as a True statement about the man who burns the bull and goat, so it re-asks the same point.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
